title: Giants reportedly release RB Najee Harris after starting him over Cam Skattebo in loss to Saints

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants reportedly release RB Najee Harris after starting him over Cam Skattebo in loss to Saints
sources.description: Harris exhibited frustration toward New York's running-back-by-committee approach after he received only four carries in the defeat to New Orleans this past Sunday.
